title: Electroplating Racks, Jigs & PCB Fixtures
description: Modular frame assemblies with spring-loaded spline contacts (V-prongs), thumb-screw clamps, high-density edge grips, and hollow square spline main bars for structural support
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 9 (Ti-3Al-2.5V) is the standard for spring-loaded contacts due to its high yield strength and excellent spring-back properties. Grade 2 for structural frame components requiring weldability and
Form: Bar/rod stock for spring contacts and splines. Sheet for clamp components. Wire for pin contacts. All spring contacts must be stress-relief annealed after forming to retain elasticity.
engineeringTrends: Process: Wire forming of V-prong spring contacts
Process: CNC machining of thumb-screw clamps and brackets
Process: TIG welding of frame assemblies
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM B348 Grade 9 for springs / Grade 2 for frame, stress-relieved, 100% spring-back tested (1000 cycles)
